senses.zh_definition: 朱迪思；源自希伯来语的女性名字。
senses.en_definition: A female given name of Hebrew origin.
senses.ms_definition: Nama diri perempuan yang berasal daripada bahasa Ibrani.
senses.nuances: 这里的 noun 具体指专有名词，即 kata nama khas。它不是表示某种事物或性质的马来语普通名词；马来语定义为说明性释义，并非 DBP 原文。下列组合是人名使用示例，不是固定词汇搭配。[Oxford：Judith](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/judith)；[Dansk Navneleksikon：Judith](https://ny.ordnet.dk/dnl/ordbog/Judith)

dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Judith akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 朱迪思女士将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Judith will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jom, aku dah siap. Bagitahu Judith kita sampai sekejap lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Marilah kita bertolak; saya sudah bersedia. Beritahu Judith bahawa kita akan tiba sebentar lagi.

messages.en: Let's go, I'm ready. Tell Judith we'll be there soon.

etymology.historical_story: Judith comes from the Hebrew name Yehudit, traditionally understood as Jewish woman or woman of Judea. Biblical storytelling helped carry the name across languages, including the story of the heroine in the Book of Judith. Its historical meaning explains the name's background; it does not identify the ethnicity or religious beliefs of a present-day bearer. [Dansk Navneleksikon：Judith](https://ny.ordnet.dk/dnl/ordbog/Judith)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Judith 当作姓名牌整块记住：开头近似英语 Judy，词尾 /θ/ 是轻轻伸舌的清辅音；不要硬拆成马来语词根。
